svg.aria-label: Cloud Standards: open standards keep your app portable. The same app runs in three cloud zones, AWS on Amazon EKS or Amazon ECS, Azure on Azure Kubernetes Service or Azure Container Apps, and Google Cloud on Google Kubernetes Engine or Google Cloud Run, and moves from one cloud to the next. Under all three sit the open standards that work on every cloud: OCI images, Kubernetes, the S3 API, and OpenTelemetry. A separate zone lists the standards bodies: NIST for the cloud definition, ISO/IEC SC 38 for cloud vocabulary, CSA for the Cloud Controls Matrix, DMTF for OVF, SNIA for CDMI, and OGF for OCCI.
svg.title: Cloud Standards: an app moves between AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud on open standards
svg.text: Open standards keep your app portable
Open standards that work on every cloud
